order: paired implementations; Python then Go in odd repetitions; reverse in even repetitions
case_order: Protocol order for eighteen remaining cases; one case per VM session; failed cases retained and unrelated cases continue only after full restoration and verified OFF.
window_rationale: 90 one-second resource samples target steady HTTP behavior in a finite laboratory lease; 30-second warm-up; five independent paired blocks retained. This departs explicitly from Placement B16 120 seconds. Shorter windows cannot represent long-term stability.
payload_rationale: 1/16/64 MiB calibrated against 64 MiB effective Go upload limit, >=1.8 GiB guest available in pilots and existing store/disk free space. Payloads streamed and independently SHA-512 verified.

deployment.authentication: real Keystone, unchanged policy; dedicated service-project validator
deployment.proxy: same original Apache route settings; only backend address switched
deployment.standalone_profile: Nova and Neutron stopped only during HTTP block; original states restored by finite systemd budget
deployment.databases: Original Python source/WSGI with its own schema/store; Go with a separate schema/store, both in the same fresh experimental native MySQL instance per case. Original MySQL/catalog untouched.
deployment.database_control_matching: Read original controls only, match experimental server before each case; record version/server UUID/controls. Original server remains independently identified.

analysis: per-run percentiles; paired repetition is independent unit; bootstrap descriptive intervals only with >=5 pairs; no causal attribution to language alone
acceptance: Five complete alternating pairs per case plus raw verification and full laboratory restoration. No pooling across v3/v4. All eighteen cases required for complete v4; SHOW v3 remains separate accepted evidence.
supersedes: v3 is retained for accepted SHOW/c1 only; v4 measures the other eighteen cases in isolated catalogs
replication_limitations: Five temporal paired blocks share each case deployment; cleanup removes visible resources but tombstones, caches and temporal correlation may remain. Bootstrap intervals are descriptive; no request-level pseudoreplication.
host_control_rationale: Prespecified v4 host gate: reject OOM, low available memory, full-memory PSI >=1% (10-second average), or >=1MiB/s swap-out for >=9 consecutive seconds. Isolated bursts and occupancy retained and reported, not silently removed. Guest zero-swap-out acceptance remains unchanged.
metric_boundaries: Latency per selected HTTP request: setup/send through bounded body read and streaming digest, excluding JSON/semantic validation. Goodput counts selected correct requests over the whole measurement interval, including time spent in unmeasured control requests. CRUD request throughput is not CRUD cycles/s. Upload MiB/s includes create/verify/delete control time in the closed loop. Range scenarios serve prefix bytes0..65535 of the declared source payload.
raw_integrity: Streaming client digests retained per response; full download SHA256/SHA512 rechecked from raw samples against independently computed payload digests. Expected first64KiB range SHA256 retained for offline revalidation. No traffic files loaded wholly into memory.
